tasks.title: Squeeze before standing up
tasks.text: Today, the 3 times you stand up from your seat, squeeze the muscle just before you rise.

tasks.title: Squeeze on the stairs
tasks.text: Today, when climbing stairs, gently squeeze the muscle on the first 3 steps.

tasks.title: Squeeze twice after urinating
tasks.text: When you've finished urinating, squeeze and release twice; it helps reduce dribbling.

tasks.title: Squeeze before coughing (Knack)
tasks.text: Today, squeeze the muscle just before you cough or sneeze.

tasks.title: Squeeze before lifting
tasks.text: Squeeze the muscle just before lifting a bag, a box or anything else, and breathe out as you lift.

tasks.title: 5 light squeezes while walking
tasks.text: While walking, squeeze lightly 5 times and let go completely.

tasks.title: 3 squeezes at a red light
tasks.text: While waiting in traffic or in a queue, do 3 slow squeezes, letting go completely in between.

tasks.title: 5 quick squeezes while the kettle boils
tasks.text: While the water for tea or coffee heats up, do 5 quick squeezes.

tasks.title: Hold while brushing your teeth
tasks.text: While brushing your teeth, hold for 5 seconds twice, then let go.

tasks.title: Stand tall on the phone
tasks.text: During a phone call, stand tall and squeeze lightly 3 times.

tasks.title: Check how you sit
tasks.text: Check your sitting posture 3 times today: sit upright and gently lift the pelvic floor without clenching your glutes.

tasks.title: Slow squeeze–release while waiting
tasks.text: While waiting for a lift or a bus, slowly squeeze 3 times, hold briefly and let go slowly.

tasks.title: 3 full-power squeezes in the morning
tasks.text: When you get up in the morning, do 3 full-power contractions standing, with long rests in between.

tasks.title: Hold for 5 seconds standing
tasks.text: During the day, while standing, hold for 5 seconds 3 times and let go completely.

tasks.title: Match it to your breath
tasks.text: Squeeze as you breathe out, let go as you breathe in: 5 reps.

tasks.title: Let go during the day
tasks.text: Stop 3 times today and consciously relax your pelvic floor, glutes and jaw.

tasks.title: 10 quick, full release
tasks.text: Do 10 quick squeezes; after each one, feel the muscle let go completely.

tasks.title: Breathing before bed
tasks.text: 6 slow breaths before bed: gently let the pelvic floor go as you breathe out.

tasks.title: Let go at your desk
tasks.text: If you've been sitting a long time, get up, relax your shoulders and glutes and take 3 deep breaths.

tasks.title: Don't strain on the toilet
tasks.text: On the toilet, take care to empty without straining, breathing out and relaxing.

tasks.title: Check in a stressful moment
tasks.text: In a tense moment, check whether you're clenching your glutes or belly; if you are, let go.

tasks.title: When tying your shoes
tasks.text: Gently squeeze the muscle before bending down or tying your shoes.

tasks.title: When getting out of bed
tasks.text: In the morning, squeeze the muscle first, then get out of bed.
